blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday received the credentials of newly appointed non-resident ambassadors to the Philippines from Jordan, Chad, Fiji and Burundi. The first was His Excellency Nasser S.H. Shraideh, ambassador of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan to the Philippines, who conveyed the warm greetings and best wishes of Jordan’s King Abdullah II bin Al Hussein to Marcos, the Presidential Communications Office said. Shraideh also highlighted the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and Jordan, anchored on friendship, mutual respect and cooperation.
